core_categories: Retail Pharmacy; Wholesale Distribution; Health and Wellness; Beauty and Personal Care; Sports Nutrition; Baby and Child Care
specialty_focus: Dis-Chem Pharmacies is a leading South African retail and wholesale pharmacy chain operating large-format stores that combine traditional dispensary services with extensive health, wellness, and convenience retail. It serves both retail consumers and wholesale clients through its internal wholesale arm, CJ Distribution, and supplies external independent pharmacies and franchises. While it offers a wide range of health products, it does not specifically specialize in wearable medical devices.
key_brands: L'Oréal, Garnier, Vaseline, Huggies, Biogen, Baby City, others
